The theme store connects to the third-party theme mirrors you configure. Browsing, searching, downloading, following and uploading send requests to those mirrors, including your IP address, device and user-agent details and, when signed in, your account token. Downloaded packages and images are stored on this device; your follows, R18 visibility choice and agreement record may be stored on the mirror as account data.

Themes are uploaded by users and are not reviewed or endorsed by the app. Apply them at your own risk. Adult (R18) themes are hidden by default and are only shown after you enable them in Content & privacy and confirm that you are of legal age.
